mod.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger Taunts
mod.author: AoE2 Arnold Taunts project
mod.description: Cosmetic, client-side Arnold Schwarzenegger replacements for AoE2DE taunts /1-/105. Every listener must install and enable the same version.

taunts.notes: Arnold: “Affirmative.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “Negative.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “All they want is food!” — The Running Man. Trim the lead-in and trailing “for God’s sake” to the approved words.
Arnold: “Down to the wood.” — Kindergarten Cop. Trim after the approved opening words.
Arnold: “Money. That’s what I need, money.” — The Running Man. Combined two adjacent soundboard snippets into the approved line.
Arnold: “Hand over the diamond, Garden Gal!” — Batman & Robin. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

Arnold: “You got to help me remember.” — Total Recall. Authentic Arnold film line from a ready-made soundboard clip. Replaces the approved “Now I remember.” wording which does not occur in the finished film.

taunts.display_name: All Hail, King of the Losers
taunts.notes: Arnold: “You’re a fucking choirboy compared to me! A choirboy!” — End of Days. Approved line is present; trim any unwanted trailing context.
Arnold: “You’re one ugly motherfucker.” — Predator. Exact line with minor transcript wording difference.

taunts.display_name: I’ll Beat You Back to Age of Empires
taunts.notes: Arnold: “You are terminated.” — Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines. Exact line.
Arnold: “Ha! You didn’t know I was gonna say that, did you?” — Last Action Hero. Standalone soundboard clip; retain Arnold’s laugh and approved line.
Arnold: “Men tried to kill me.” — Total Recall. Soundboard clip says “Some men just tried to kill me”; trim “Some” if desired.

taunts.display_name: Sure Blame it on Your ISP
taunts.notes: Arnold: “So basically, you’re lying.” — True Lies. Trim after the approved opening phrase.
Arnold: “Come on, Bennett. Let’s party.” — Commando. Exact line despite misspelled source slug.

taunts.display_name: Don’t Point That Thing at Me
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I’ll give you ten minutes to prove it, and then I shoot you.” — Last Action Hero. Authentic standalone Arnold line. Replaces “Don’t shoot me”/“No shoot” which is spoken by Danny rather than Arnold.
Arnold: “Someone’s coming.” — The Running Man. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: It is Good To be the King
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I am the hero.” — Last Action Hero. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “You have to have faith.” — End of Days. Actual spoken wording is “We have to have faith.”
Arnold: “I’m back.” — Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: My Granny Could Scrap Better Than That
taunts.notes: Arnold: “You hit like a vegetarian.” — Escape Plan. Exact full-film soundboard clip; trim surrounding dialogue during preprocessing if required.
Arnold: “Could I speak to the drug dealer of the house, please?” — Last Action Hero. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “Don’t do that.” — Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines. Exact soundboard clip.
Arnold: “It’s a beautiful day and we’re out killing drug dealers.” — Last Action Hero. Trim the trailing question to the approved words.
Arnold: “Jesus, Marge! What the fuck?” — End of Days. Exact line.
Arnold: “Do it! Come on! Kill me!” — Predator. Approved words are present; trim to preferred delivery.

taunts.display_name: The Wonder, The Wonder, The Noooooo
taunts.notes: Arnold: “This is going to be very difficult to explain.” — Terminator: Dark Fate. Ready-made quote clip; exact film wording is: This will be very hard to explain to Alicia. Approved wording was a paraphrase; use the spoken wording.

taunts.display_name: You Played 2 Hours to Die Like This
taunts.notes: Arnold: “It is in your nature to destroy yourselves.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Yeah Well You Should See the Other Guy
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Yes, fine. No problems.” — Red Heat. Exact standalone clip from Realm of Darkness Red Heat soundboard.
Arnold: “Crom laughs at your four winds.” — Conan the Barbarian. Exact line.
Arnold: “Come with me if you want to live.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line.
Arnold: “It’s showtime!” — The Running Man. Exact line.
Arnold: “STOP IT!” — Kindergarten Cop. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “You should clone yourself.” — The 6th Day. Trim after “You should clone yourself.”
Arnold: “I hope Mr. Bane can swim.” — Batman & Robin. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “Abort mission. We return back to base.” — The Running Man. Exact soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Wait for my Signal to Attack
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Stay here. I’ll be back.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

Arnold: “Of course, I think I’m gonna win.” — Pumping Iron. Authentic Arnold documentary line from a ready-made soundboard clip. Replaces “I want to be number one.” which is not spoken in Pumping Iron.
Arnold: “I need your help.” — Eraser. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “Trust me.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “If it bleeds, we can kill it.” — Predator. Exact line.
Arnold: “I’m not into politics. I’m into survival.” — The Running Man. Trim the first sentence; retain the approved politics/survival line.
Arnold: “Old. Not obsolete.” — Terminator Genisys. Ready-made quote clip; exact spoken wording is: I'm old. Not obsolete.
Arnold: “Now, this is the plan.” — Total Recall. Trim after “This is the plan.”

taunts.display_name: How Many Resources do you Have
taunts.notes: Arnold: “How much is that?” — Jingle All the Way. Actual Jingle All the Way wording is “How much?”
Arnold: “Get to the chopper!” — Predator. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Flare the Location of Your Army
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Where is this?” — Eraser. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Attack in the Direction of the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Follow him.” — Commando. Trim the longer soundboard sentence down to “Follow him.”
Arnold: “I’m counting on you, buddy.” — Total Recall. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Build a Forward Base at the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Pull over here.” — True Lies. Trim the trailing “This is good.”

taunts.display_name: Build a Fortification at the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I want a defensive position.” — Predator. Trim after “position” to match the approved excerpt.

taunts.display_name: Keep Your Army Close to Mine and Fight With Me
taunts.notes: Arnold: “As long as I’m with you, I’m in no danger.” — Twins. Exact film audio says: As long as I'm with you, I won't let anyone harm you, okay? Approved wording was a paraphrase; use the spoken wording.

taunts.display_name: Build a Market at the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “We’re all businessmen.” — Jingle All the Way. Trim after the approved opening sentence if needed.

taunts.display_name: Rebuild Your Base at the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I want my life back.” — The 6th Day. Exact full-film soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Build a Wall Between the two Flared Locations
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I can’t self-terminate. You must lower me into the steel.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Authentic Arnold film line from a ready-made soundboard clip. Replaces the non-film paraphrase “You go. I cannot.”

taunts.display_name: Build a Wall Around Your Town
taunts.notes: Arnold: “We make a stand now, or there will be nobody left to go to the chopper.” — Predator. Authentic Arnold film line from a ready-made soundboard clip. Replaces “Set up a perimeter.” which is not spoken by Arnold in Predator.

taunts.display_name: Train Units Which Counter the Enemy’s Army
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Take two of these, and call me in the morning.” — Batman & Robin. Combined two adjacent soundboard snippets into the approved line.
Arnold: “Enough talk.” — Conan the Destroyer. Exact line; soundboard labels film imprecisely.

taunts.display_name: Prepare to Send me all Your Resources so I can Vanquish Our Foes
taunts.notes: Arnold: “I need your clothes, your boots, and your motorcycle.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line.
Arnold: “One more thing: I work alone.” — Eraser. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Prepare to Train a Large Army, I’ll Send You as Many Resources as I can Spare
taunts.notes: Arnold: “They need a leader. They need someone with experience.” — The Running Man. Exact soundboard clip.
Arnold: “I’ll be back.” — The Terminator. Exact line.
Arnold: “Consider that a divorce.” — Total Recall. Trim the setup and retain “Consider that a divorce.”
Arnold: “Let off some steam, Bennett.” — Commando. Exact line.
Arnold: “Tonight, hell freezes over!” — Batman & Robin. Exact soundboard clip.
Arnold: “You’re fired.” — True Lies. Exact line.
Arnold: “It’s not a tumor!” — Kindergarten Cop. Trim to “It’s not a tumor!”
Arnold: “Put that cookie down! Now!” — Jingle All the Way. Verify that the file includes the final “Now!” before review.
Arnold: “Here is Subzero. Now, plain zero.” — The Running Man. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Delete the Object on the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “It must be destroyed.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Clean standalone MP3 from Terminator Files soundboard.
Arnold: “I let him go.” — Commando. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “He won’t be needing it.” — Commando. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “See you at the party, Richter!” — Total Recall. Exact line.
Arnold: “Stick around.” — Predator. Exact line.
Arnold: “Don’t disturb my friend. He’s dead tired.” — Commando. Trim the optional opening “Excuse me.”
Arnold: “To be or not to be? Not to be.” — Last Action Hero. Exact line.
Arnold: “You want to be a farmer? Here’s a couple of acres.” — Last Action Hero. Approved line is present.
Arnold: “You’re luggage.” — Eraser. Exact Arnold delivery; source transcript omits “are.”
Arnold: “Who is your daddy, and what does he do?” — Kindergarten Cop. Trim the introductory sentence.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With a mix of Archers and Skirmishers
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Stop whining!” — Kindergarten Cop. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Scout Cavalry
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Everybody, chill!” — Batman & Robin. Clean standalone clip; exact spoken wording is: All right, everyone! Chill.
Arnold: “Allow me to break the ice.” — Batman & Robin. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Eagle Scouts
taunts.notes: Arnold: “What killed the dinosaurs? The Ice Age!” — Batman & Robin. Exact line.
Arnold: “He had to split.” — The Running Man. Retain the setup if it improves the punchline; otherwise trim to approved words.
Arnold: “What a hothead.” — The Running Man. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Cavalry Archers
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Crom!” — Conan the Barbarian. Exact shout.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Unique Units
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Get your ass to Mars.” — Total Recall. Trim the setup and retain “Get your ass to Mars.”
Arnold: “Give these people air!” — Total Recall. Trim the Cohaagen address if desired.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Battle Elephants
taunts.notes: Arnold: “You think this is the real Quaid? It is!” — Total Recall. Exact line despite misspelled source slug.
Arnold: “No problemo.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line.
Arnold: “I need a vacation.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Monks and Mangonels
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Chill out, dickwad.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line despite misspelled source slug.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Eagle Warriors
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Dillon! You son of a bitch!” — Predator. Exact line despite misspelled source slug.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Halberdiers and Rams
taunts.notes: Arnold: “CIA got you pushing too many pencils?” — Predator. Exact soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Elite Eagle Warriors
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Remember when I promised to kill you last? I lied.” — Commando. Approved exchange is present; retain or trim Sully’s reply during review.
Arnold: “I eat Green Berets for breakfast.” — Commando. Trim after the approved sentence if desired.
Arnold: “Knock, knock.” — Commando. Exact line.
Arnold: “Fuck you, asshole.” — Commando. Commando exchange; isolate Arnold’s second delivery.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Fire Galleys
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Rubber baby buggy bumpers!” — Last Action Hero. Exact line despite misspelled source slug.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Demolition Rafts
taunts.notes: Arnold: “AAAAAAARGH!” — Total Recall. Martian decompression scream from soundboard.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With War Galleys
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Milk is for babies. When you grow up, you drink beer.” — Pumping Iron. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Fire Ships
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Money talks and bullshit walks.” — Twins. Exact standalone soundboard clip.

taunts.display_name: Attack the Enemy With Unique Warships
taunts.notes: Arnold: “Cocainum!” — Red Heat. Exact line.

taunts.display_name: Use an Onager to cut Down Trees at the Flared Location
taunts.notes: Arnold: “AAAAAAARGH!” — Predator. Full-volume jungle battle roar; select the strongest short section during normalization.
Arnold: “You just gotta keep coming back stronger.” — Pumping Iron. Exact standalone soundboard clip.
Arnold: “Hasta la vista, baby.” — Terminator 2: Judgment Day. Exact line.
